lyrics.own:
[Verse 1]
Morning breaks above the river
Golden light on window glass
Every shadow starts to shiver
Waiting for the night to pass

[Chorus]
Carry me across the water
Take my hand and hold it tight
Sing it louder, sing it brighter
Till the dark becomes the light

[Verse 2]
Silver birds across the city
Paper boats along the stream
Nothing here is cold or bitter
Walking slowly through a dream

[Chorus]
Carry me across the water
Take my hand and hold it tight
Sing it louder, sing it brighter
Till the dark becomes the light
lyrics.same:
[Verse 1]
Evening falls above the harbor
Silver light on painted glass
Every sailor starts to wander
Hoping for the storm to pass

[Chorus]
Carry me across the water
Take my hand and hold it tight
Sing it louder, sing it brighter
Till the dark becomes the light

[Verse 2]
Yellow kites across the valley
Wooden boats along the shore
Nothing here is dark or empty
Running slowly to the door

[Chorus]
Carry me across the water
Take my hand and hold it tight
Sing it louder, sing it brighter
Till the dark becomes the light
lyrics.more:
[Verse 1]
Morning breaks above the silent river
Golden light on every window glass
Every shadow slowly starts to shiver
Waiting for the longest night to pass

[Chorus]
Carry me across the water
Take my hand and hold it tight
Sing it louder, sing it brighter
Till the dark becomes the light

[Verse 2]
Silver birds fly across the city
Paper boats drift along the stream
Nothing here is too cold or bitter
Walking slowly through a new dream

[Chorus]
Carry me across the water
Take my hand and hold it tight
Sing it louder, sing it brighter
Till the dark becomes the light
lyrics.less:
[Verse 1]
Morning on the river
Light on window glass
Shadows start to shiver
Waiting night to pass

[Chorus]
Carry me across the water
Take my hand and hold it tight
Sing it louder, sing it brighter
Till the dark becomes the light

[Verse 2]
Silver birds across the bay
Paper boats on the stream
Nothing here feels bitter now
Walking slow through a dream

[Chorus]
Carry me across the water
Take my hand and hold it tight
Sing it louder, sing it brighter
Till the dark becomes the light

lyrics.own:
[Verse 1]
Город спит под белым снегом
Фонари горят в окне
Я иду за первым светом
По заснеженной земле

[Chorus]
Мы летим над этим миром
Выше крыш и облаков
Наше сердце бьётся в ритме
Самых светлых в мире снов

[Verse 2]
Утро красит небо алым
Тает иней на стекле
Я встречаю день усталым
Но счастливым на земле

[Chorus]
Мы летим над этим миром
Выше крыш и облаков
Наше сердце бьётся в ритме
Самых светлых в мире снов

[Verse 2]
Вечер красит море алым
Тает солнце на воде
Я встречаю ночь усталым
Но свободным на земле

[Chorus]
Мы летим над этим миром
Выше крыш и облаков
Наше сердце бьётся в ритме
Самых светлых в мире снов

Утро красит всё небо алым
Тает наш иней на стекле
Я встречаю свой день усталым
Но я счастливым на земле

Выше крыш и облаков
Наше сердце бьётся в ритме
